analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, complete supplied BASE source, installer HEAD source and setup patch. SandboxInstaller.swift:107-137 adds disk capability detection and repeated --disk/value argument pairs, shared by planning and installation. Existing HTTPS-only download, size limit and owner-only staging remain unchanged. SandboxSetupCommand.swift:74-75 normalizes paths; :174-186 checks explicit disks or selects and checks an interactive choice; :291-367 adds volume validation and separately confirmed ownership enabling; :435-446 refuses failed disk plans rather than using an internal-disk estimate; :480-485 rejects explicit disks when the script does not advertise support. No concrete regression is established: paths are assembled as argument elements rather than interpolated shell commands, and existing unverified-installer execution risk under TB-013/T-061 is not new.
Relevant contracts are A-019/TB-013/T-061 (owner-account execution), A-018/TB-012/T-059 (availability), and external-storage confidentiality/integrity assumptions. T-041's encrypted inference-cache protections must not be assumed to protect these VM work disks. No supplied change directly modifies inference encryption, attestation, serving authorization, keys or billing controls.
Integration must examine SandboxWorkDisk.absolutePath/volume/problem/candidates/enableOwnership, referenced at SandboxSetupCommand.swift:156-162 and :291-367: verify filesystem/ownership checks, privileged command argument handling and mount replacement behavior. The external installer's disk handling must confirm private storage, missing-drive behavior and refusal to disrupt running paid jobs; the supplied CLI cannot establish those controls. Reconcile whether removable VM/job storage and the sudo ownership operation need additions to TB-013/A-019. These dependencies are outside this source batch, so their absence is a coverage limit, not a vulnerability finding.
